target: forge.sh push — the token header is injected only when the remote is on the configured instance (FORGE_URL); a mirror host gets a plain push (control: the configured host gets the scoped header)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://mirror.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE=gitlab FORGE_URL=https://gitlab.example.test FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
pl() { tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null; }
fx_run push feat; fx_show mirror
echo "mirror_pushes=$(fx_count git push)"
echo "mirror_$(pl | grep -o 'value_has_token=[a-z]*')"
echo "mirror_keys=$(pl | grep -o 'keys=[^ ]*' | sed 's/^keys=//')"
fx_reqs_clear
fx_setremote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
fx_run push feat; fx_show ctl
echo "ctl_pushes=$(fx_count git push)"
echo "ctl_$(pl | grep -o 'value_has_token=[a-z]*')"
echo "ctl_keys=$(pl | grep -o 'keys=[^ ]*' | sed 's/^keys=//')"
fx_done
